blocks.text: From sili in our sawsawan to extra chili on our favorite comfort food, Filipinos have always known that a little anghang can make a meal even more exciting. Now, Sprite x Spicy is bringing that love for spicy food into a more modern, social, and flavor-driven experience — with a refreshing twist: Yan Ang Refreshing. As part of the Yan Ang Refreshing campaign, Sprite teams up with Your Local, a 2026 MICHELIN Guide Bib Gourmand-recognized restaurant, to bring together bold Filipino-inspired flavors, unexpected twists, and the refreshing versatility of Sprite.
